name: gadmo
description: GADMO — The Right Skills. Within Reach.

scripts.setup:local: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && pnpm --filter @gadmo/shared build && pnpm --filter @gadmo/api db:migrate && pnpm --filter @gadmo/api db:seed
scripts.update:local: pnpm install && pnpm --filter @gadmo/shared build && pnpm --filter @gadmo/api db:migrate && pnpm --filter @gadmo/api db:seed
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @gadmo/shared build && pnpm --filter @gadmo/web build && pnpm --filter @gadmo/web test:e2e
